blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Andres Aldeguer scored a late penalty to give the Philippine men’s U-23 football team a 2-1 win over Kuwait on Tuesday to end its Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 campaign on a high note at Minato Soccer Field. Aldeguer came through with the decisive goal in the first minute of stoppage time that propelled the Philippines to its first victory in the Asian Games men’s football scene in 68 years.
